description: The flow rate (gpm) your pool pump must deliver for a target turnover time, your actual turnover from a flow meter reading, and whether your filter is big enough for that flow. Formula: Required flow (gpm) = gallons ÷ (turnover hours × 60). Actual turnover (hours) = gallons ÷ (measured gpm × 60). Filter max flow = filter area × rated gpm per sq ft.

filter_area_sqft.description: Filter area (from the filter label, 0 to skip) (sq ft); default 0

filter_rate_gpm_per_sqft.description: Max filter rate (from the filter label) (gpm/sq ft); default 0

measured_gpm.description: Flow meter reading (0 to skip) (gpm); default 60

name: calc_pool_turnover
title: Pool Turnover Rate & Pump GPM Calculator
